name: Xianheng International Science&Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xianheng International Science&Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, production, and marketing of critical emergency rescue tools and essential supplies, primarily serving the electric power sector. The company's extensive product line encompasses a broad spectrum of specialized electrical construction equipment. This includes various tools for crimping, cutting, and processing busbars, hydraulic pumps, angle steel and screw processing devices, as well as products for cable handling, laying, and preparation, alongside railway-specific tools. Xianheng International also provides a wide range of lifting and access solutions, from mini cranes to a comprehensive assortment of aerial work platforms. These access solutions feature diverse models such as electric, self-propelled, diesel, and double-mast scissor lifts, mobile electric scissor lifts, self-propelled articulated and telescopic booms, sleeve-type platforms, super material lifts, and truck-mounted platforms. Further offerings include precision instruments like cable fault locators, bolt tensioners, hydraulic cylinders, and torque wrenches, complemented by a variety of lighting products. For manual tasks, they supply a full suite of hand tools, including insulated sets (both VDE compliant and general purpose). In addition to its industrial equipment, Xianheng International distributes vital personal protective and medical supplies. This category features disposable and medical face masks, protective respirators, non-contact thermometers, protective clothing, isolation gowns, gloves, goggles, and face shields. The company, established in 1989, is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
